scope: complete production: three tiers, fitted humanoid rig, robe deformation, casting sockets, textures, LODs and verified game integration

review.playback_note: All nine clips recorded at 1x and 0.5x from final textured exports. Agent inspected timed sampled images/contact sheets, close views and numeric deformation reports; no claim of continuous human video review.
review.user_accepted_scope: 2026-10-18: user said "good" after the lining correction; corrected Necromancer accepted in full.

user_acceptance_record.scope: Corrected Necromancer including breastplate lining and collar seam

references_hd.agent_gate: passed: all five views inspected separately and together; coherent armour, face, robe, cuffs and five-digit hands; rear heels corrected; true alpha verified

correction_ledger.finding: Smart Topology v1 has four digits on each hand and malformed eye shells.
correction_ledger.cause: Generated topology omitted a finger on each hand; local parts close-ups confirm the defect.
correction_ledger.action: Preserve v1; request same reviewed reference through newer meshy-t2.5 at 15000 triangles for direct comparison.
correction_ledger.selected_revision: v2 plus local corrections recorded in work/geometry_selected.json

correction_ledger.finding: Initial robe intersected concealed legs and visible shoes during movement and fall.
correction_ledger.cause: Pelvis-only cloth targets did not enclose the stride; helper bones were initially connected and ignored translation.
correction_ledger.action: Leg-envelope targets, shortened strides, fitted slippers, hem allowance, disconnected cloth controls and explicit neutral location tracks. Remove concealed trousers from export but retain hidden fitting proxy.

correction_ledger.finding: Head hair passed slightly below the floor during the backward fall.
correction_ledger.cause: Body grounding ignored the long hair thickness.
correction_ledger.action: Ground the rendered visible surface after cloth bake; preserve actual hair floor contact.

correction_ledger.finding: Body texture return omitted microscopic hem slivers.
correction_ledger.cause: Four sub-0.2 mm hem triangles were unstable in UV correspondence.
correction_ledger.action: Weld only those local hem vertices; transfer returned body UVs within 0.06 mm, head exactly.

correction_ledger.finding: Separate head/body palette ranges prevented the standard atlas merge.
correction_ledger.cause: Independently fitted ramps were different despite using the same native palette.
correction_ledger.action: Use identical native ramps on body and head; bright iris values select the upper ramp.

correction_ledger.finding: User: both cuirass sections bend like cloth and the white cords slide at their fastening.
correction_ledger.cause: The generated torso was one cloth/metal surface with blended spine and arm weights; cord roots followed a different spine transform.
correction_ledger.action: Separate rigid metal over recessed flexible black lining; bind the complete cuirass, knot and cord roots to B_Spine1. Blend the connected robe waist beneath it. Reparent and rebake cord swing/collision and death settling. Rebuild all LODs and refresh installed and viewer assets.

correction_ledger.finding: User: black lining leaks through the breastplate in most animations, e.g. cast frame 20; otherwise good.
correction_ledger.cause: Covered lining retained deforming torso weights beneath rigid metal.
correction_ledger.action: Bind covered lining to the same B_Spine1 transform as the plate. Fit the neck base to that collar with a smooth transition into the existing head motion. Preserve outer sleeves, metal, cords, textures and clip timings.

rig_validation.G2: Native narrow shoulders retained; measured ratios in work/proportions.json.
rig_validation.G3: Measured wrist, ankle and connectivity-fitted finger joints; reviewed x-rays.
rig_validation.G6: All animated roles sampled: floor >= 3 mm, no visible shoe/robe containment. Sleeve skin and new inner-shirt lining are reported separately.
rig_validation.G7: Final textured 1x/0.5x playback samples, close views and native indoor/outdoor gameplay inspected; see review/playback and review/ingame.
rig_validation.cloth: 48 robe, 12 cuff, 4 hair and 4 tassel controls; short leg strides, running hem allowance, floor grounding; hidden trousers retained as editable fitting proxy only.

limitations: Browser preview uses four skin weights; native game uses eight.
